commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original polished educational FOUR-panel comic, one wide landscape image with exactly FOUR equal-width vertical panels in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, left-to-right, aligned boundaries at 25%, 50%, 75%, thin warm gray dividers. Aim for 3:1 landscape canvas. Each quarter contains one complete scene, all heads, paws and props safely inside its own quarter. Reference images are CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY, never copy their watermarks. Preserve Fangpian's golden-yellow tiger family: round head and ears, brown forehead and cheek stripes, cream muzzle and belly, brown nose, large warm brown eyes, chunky little paws and striped tail. Soft high-quality 3D clay illustration, warm ivory background with a few meaningful scene props, yellow with restrained teal/coral accents, readable silhouette, varied camera angles and expressions. Each story's protagonist keeps exactly the same clothes across all four panels. Use two arms and two legs per tiger, coherent anatomy, no floating limbs. Any AI companion is a small neutral white rounded robot with teal face. Absolutely NO letters, text, numerals, captions, speech bubbles, logos, watermark or URLs anywhere, including screens, books and papers; use simple pictograms and blank horizontal lines only. Captions will be added in website HTML. Four distinct sequential actions, never four repeated poses. No outer title or big empty header, artwork fills each panel. No claims that AI verification guarantees correctness. Anatomical priority: every character has exactly TWO arms total. If both paws hold objects, NO extra chin-touching, pointing or head-scratching paw. Scenes below are visual directions, never render any of the supplied Chinese text. Keep all dividers straight at exact quarter boundaries. Preserve the same protagonist outfit in all panels. Do not add humans, logos, written language, numbers, badges declaring verified truth or decorative banners. All living supporting characters must also be golden-yellow tigers from this exact family. No dogs, rabbits, owls, other animal species or humans.

lessons.takeaway: 把工作流变成可执行候选，在预算内搜索并评测。

lessons.title: 四格看懂：让 Harness 改进自己

panels.label: 把失败归成模式

panels.alt: 修理虎把不合格新模块放进退回盒，重新安装保存好的旧模块。
